The three mockups and the current build are pictured and scored. None moved the critic off 2, so none is close to the finish line of 4.

All four sets (current build, A, B, C) scored 2. Each critic run scored the three screens (19, 33, 37) together as one set.

- **A, quiet:** every box is the same panel, with a thin border and small round corners. Small text is one size.
- **B, bare:** only the ammo card, the hp/stamina block and the hotbar keep a box. Everything else is text on a soft shadow. It reads thin on the pink floor of screen 33.
- **C, one rail:** the corner widgets join into one panel with hairline dividers. One panel holds cash and run info, and one holds the left feed.

Every critic run named the same top problems, and none of the mockups touch them because they only change drawing:
- the controls legend sitting in the middle of the play space;
- alerts shown twice, as a banner and again in the left feed;
- the extraction banner glued to the hostiles strip and crowding the hotbar;
- the clock not being a 56px hero number.

Several of these touch his feed-all order and the controls card he wants kept on, so they need his answers first. The notes carry the plain-words line, the draw functions each mockup changes and what a player sees.

**Not shipped, uncommitted:** the scratch pages `tools/fxmock-A.html`, `-B` and `-C`, which are not meant to be committed.

**`accept.json` overwritten:** the critic runs overwrote the entries for screens 19, 33 and 37. Their score (2) and need (4) are unchanged, but the verdict and findings text is now mockup C's. I logged it in `alarms.md`, and the next real critic run on those screens will fix it.

The write-up is in `tools/handoff/console/notes/112-raid-hud-style-mockups.md`, with pictures in `notes/shots/112-mockups/<now|A|B|C>/`. The mockup code is in `notes/112-mockups/mock-A.js`, `mock-B.js` and `mock-C.js`. The runnable build scripts are `mk-cw-mockA.ps1`, `mk-cw-mockB.ps1` and `mk-cw-mockC.ps1` in the scratchpad. The older copies under `notes/112-mockups/` put the code outside the game's script and won't work.

NEXT: the coordinator puts A, B and C in front of him. If he picks one, I'll write it as a real cw- key.

TASK DONE
